## GW_05.1_aq

```{r}
Maq1 <- inla(lg3_std ~ hydroyear_std + type + soilclass + 
               f(loc_code,
                model = "iid") + 
               f(cluster_id,
                model = "iid"),
            data = gw51a,
            control.compute = list(waic = TRUE))
summary(Maq1)
Maq1$summary.hyperpar
margs <- Maq1$marginals.hyperpar
lapply(margs, function(marg) c(stdev = inla.emarginal(invsqrt, marg)))
walk2(margs, names(margs), function(marg, hyperpar) {
  inla.tmarginal(fun = invsqrt, marg) %>% 
  as_tibble %>%  
  qplot(data = ., x = x, y = y, geom = "line", 
        xlab = expression(sigma),
        main = str_replace(hyperpar, "Precision", "Standard deviation")) %>% 
    print
})
```

```{r}
gw51a %>% 
  mutate(fitted = Maq1$summary.fitted.values$mean) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = lg3_std, y = fitted)) + geom_point() + coord_equal()
```



```{r}
Maq2 <- inla(lg3_std ~ type + 
               f(loc_code,
                model = "iid") +

summary(Maq2)
```
